## Aalyria - Senior Software Engineer, Backend

🔗 [Apply](https://ats.rippling.com/aalyria-careers/jobs/fba79811-bcca-4048-b117-1b49f246084c)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Backend engineer building Aalyria’s Spacetime platform for 5G NTN, Direct-to-Cell, and satellite-network orchestration. Developing distributed cloud-native systems with C++, Golang, Java, gRPC, and Kubernetes.
Backend engineer building 5G satellite-network orchestration software at Aalyria
- Salary: $165,000 - $215,000 per year
- Tech stack: Cloud, Distributed Systems, GRPC, Java, Kubernetes, C++, Go
- Develop and maintain the Spacetime platform using C++, Golang, Java, gRPC, and Protocol Buffers
- Build scalable, distributed systems on Kubernetes
- Develop Spacetime features for 5G NTN and Direct-to-Cell orchestration
- Implement RIC/SMO capabilities for the NTN, network model extensions, and federation APIs for TN-NTN coordination
- Translate 3GPP and O-RAN concepts and interface specifications into clean, well-tested software with solution architects
- Integrate with other Aalyria platform components for end-to-end functionality
- Develop and maintain software design and implementation documentation
- Stay up-to-date with 5G NTN, O-RAN, and satellite communications technologies
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science / Engineering or equivalent work experience
- Professional experience working in C++, Golang, and/or Java
- Knowledge of gRPC and Protocol Buffers
- Experience building and operating distributed systems
- Familiarity with wireless communications, modeling of wireless performance, or satellite communications
- Strong technical communication skills and ability to communicate across multiple functions
- Applicants must meet U.S. government export-control eligibility requirements: qualify as a U.S. person, be eligible to access export-controlled information without export authorization, or be eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the necessary export authorization
- Preferred: Professional software development experience on systems related to 3GPP 4G/5G networks

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Backend engineer building Aalyria’s Spacetime platform for 5G NTN, Direct-to-Cell, and satellite-network orchestration. Developing distributed cloud-native systems with C++, Golang, Java, gRPC, and Kubernetes.
Backend engineer building 5G satellite-network orchestration software at Aalyria
Role description:
• Develop and maintain the Spacetime platform using C++, Golang, Java, gRPC, and Protocol Buffers
• Build scalable, distributed systems on Kubernetes
• Develop Spacetime features for 5G NTN and Direct-to-Cell orchestration
• Implement RIC/SMO capabilities for the NTN, network model extensions, and federation APIs for TN-NTN coordination
• Translate 3GPP and O-RAN concepts and interface specifications into clean, well-tested software with solution architects
• Integrate with other Aalyria platform components for end-to-end functionality
• Develop and maintain software design and implementation documentation
• Stay up-to-date with 5G NTN, O-RAN, and satellite communications technologies
• Write clean, maintainable, efficient code
• Troubleshoot and debug software issues
• Design and build distributed systems in a modern, cloud-native codebase
• Work with 3GPP/NTN solution architects on standards and systems expertise
Role requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science / Engineering or equivalent work experience
• Professional experience working in C++, Golang, and/or Java
• Knowledge of gRPC and Protocol Buffers
• Experience building and operating distributed systems
• Familiarity with wireless communications, modeling of wireless performance, or satellite communications
• Strong technical communication skills and ability to communicate across multiple functions
• Applicants must meet U.S. government export-control eligibility requirements: qualify as a U.S. person, be eligible to access export-controlled information without export authorization, or be eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the necessary export authorization
• Preferred: Professional software development experience on systems related to 3GPP 4G/5G networks
• Preferred: Hands-on experience with O-RAN architecture, including SMO, Non-RT/Near-RT RIC, rApps, xApps, or O-RAN interfaces
• Preferred: Familiarity with 3GPP NTN and Direct-to-Cell / Supplemental Coverage from Space concepts
• Preferred: Experience implementing or integrating 3GPP or O-RAN APIs and data models
• Preferred: Experience with wireless standards work or applying 3GPP/ETSI/O-RAN specifications in production software
• Preferred: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native telecom deployments
• Preferred: Professional experience optimizing distributed-system performance
• Preferred: Experience in aerospace & defense or telecommunications
• Preferred: Familiarity with software-defined networking platforms
Benefits:
• Innovative environment at a cutting-edge aerospace communications technology company
• Direct contribution to critical national security programs and initiatives
• Professional development and advancement opportunities
• Collaborative, supportive, and inclusive workplace
• Flexible working arrangements including hybrid remote/in-office schedules
• Comprehensive benefits
• 401(k)
• Dental insurance
• Vision insurance
• Health insurance
• Life insurance
• Paid time off
• Equity options
Tech stack:
Cloud, Distributed Systems, GRPC, Java, Kubernetes, C++, Go
